$comment: Sealed reports across operators (docs/report-envelope.md, bipe-chat/bipe#697). tools/gen.mjs writes the TypeScript types to bipe-api src/generated/reports.ts. The reference checks are tools/lib/reports.mjs.

ReportEnvelope.description: The plain envelope. The core and the receiving operator read it without the private key. Its exact bytes are the HPKE AAD.

report_id.description: UUID v4, lower case. The reporter's client makes it.

to.description: operator: a report to the operator of the reported user. associacao: an appeal or cross-operator abuse to the associação.

kid.description: The recipient key ID in the operator list (report_keys of the operator, or appeal_keys).

target_operator.description: The server_name of the operator that receives the report.

target_user.description: The reported Matrix user ID. Its server part equals target_operator.

flagger_id.description: Only with reporter flagger: the accredited trusted flagger.

envelope.description: The ReportEnvelope as UTF-8 JSON bytes, base64url without padding.

enc.description: The HPKE encapsulated key (32 bytes), base64url without padding.

ct.description: The HPKE ciphertext of the ReportBody JSON bytes, with the tag, base64url without padding.

ReportBody.description: The sealed body. Only the holder of the recipient private key reads it.

context.description: Messages around the reported ones, in time order.

event.description: The event exactly as the reporter's homeserver served it, with its signatures and unsigned fields. For an encrypted message this is the m.room.encrypted event.

decrypted.description: The decrypted event (type and content) as the reporter's client shows it. An unproved claim: Matrix has no message franking.

ReportMedia.description: An encrypted file of a reported message: the fields of its Matrix EncryptedFile that let the operator fetch and decrypt it.

url.description: The mxc URI of the ciphertext.

key.description: The AES-256-CTR key: the JWK k value, base64url without padding.

iv.description: The IV, unpadded standard base64, as in the event.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ciphertext, unpadded standard base64, as in hashes.sha256.
